requirements.text: A1 — Build height/setback rule families for R1–R4 and R6–R12 (all subfamilies a real lot can carry, e.g. R6A/R6B/R7-2/R8X/R9-1/R10A), to the same discipline as the accepted R5 pilot: citation anchors to the captured legal text with digest fail-closed loading, deterministic evaluator rules, exact units, focused tests, independent review, DRAFT/needs-review status until G6. One bounded family (or coherent family group) per gated ledger task citing D-045:D-045-R001.
requirements.required_harness: per-family rule files + evaluator tests green in CI; coverage surface honestly reports which families are assessed
requirements.required_evidence: accepted ledger tasks citing D-045-R001 covering every named district family

requirements.text: A2 — Build the geometry-dependent rule mechanics: street-width-dependent height limits, sky-exposure planes, permitted obstructions/overhangs. Each mechanic ships together with the data inputs it needs (never a rule computing on guessed geometry); where an input is unavailable the result stays an honest 'no supported estimate' / not-assessed, never a manufactured number.
requirements.required_harness: geometry-dependent evaluations reproduce documented ZR examples in tests; missing-input branches proven

requirements.text: B2 (dependency of A2) — Build the street-width / mapped-street data connector under the full connector discipline: official-source research first, source-registry record, verbatim capture with provenance, recorded fixtures, contract tests, G1 data-contract verification. The existing MapPLUTO parcel-geometry connector (M5-T020) is reused, not duplicated.
requirements.required_harness: connector fixtures byte-verified against the live official source at G1; unit/CRS honesty proven
requirements.required_evidence: accepted connector ledger task citing D-045-R003

requirements.text: A3 — Build the contextual / Quality Housing variants and inclusionary-housing-style bonus programs, with careful legal sourcing (these materially change caps). Bonus math must name its program and preconditions on every output; any precondition the program cannot verify from official data renders as an explicit assumption or professional-review flag, never as a silently applied bonus.
requirements.required_harness: per-program rule tests incl. precondition-unverifiable branches

requirements.text: Commercial districts — Build the C-district rule families (commercial FAR and the mechanics needed for honest feasibility output in C districts), including commercial-overlay math where an overlay changes a lot's result. Same citation/test/review/DRAFT discipline as R001.
requirements.required_harness: per-family rule files + tests green in CI; overlay interaction cases covered

requirements.text: Manufacturing districts — Build the M-district rule families (M1–M3, including mixed/paired MX contexts where a lot presents them). Same citation/test/review/DRAFT discipline as R001.
requirements.required_harness: per-family rule files + tests green in CI

requirements.text: A4 — Build special purpose districts and waterfront zoning as later waves after the citywide base (R001–R006) is broad, per the owner-selected option wording ('later waves'). These large self-contained rule bodies enter one bounded district/body at a time under the same discipline.
requirements.required_harness: per-body rule packs + tests; coverage surface names each special district assessed vs not

requirements.text: SEQUENCING — Work proceeds 'one reviewed family at a time' (owner-accepted option wording): bounded tasks under the normal G0–G7 gated process, never a monolithic all-districts task. The in-flight M5-T023/M5-T024 completions and the D-043 owner deploy walkthrough are not displaced. Within that, ordering is the orchestrator's replanning judgment (suggested: A1 → A2+B2 → A3 → C → M → A4), recorded via /replan-project in the master plan.
requirements.required_harness: master-plan campaign structure of bounded tasks; each cites its D-045 requirement id
requirements.required_evidence: master-plan update recorded by the orchestrator

requirements.text: PRESERVATION / SCOPE LIMIT — This directive changes coverage scope ONLY. Unchanged: every rule stays DRAFT/needs-review until G6 qualified legal review (owner-gated Section 20 hard stop); no compliance declarations; dependency policy §G for any new package; the expansion hold outside the released lot-outline increment; PR #241 unmerged; D-043 internal-only deploy posture. Gap-list rows NOT named here (B3 DOB, B4 landmarks, B5 ACRIS, C2, C3, E1–E3, group D) remain untriaged candidates under D-041-R003 — this directive is the owner triage for its named groups only.
requirements.required_harness: ledger contents; no task cites D-045 for out-of-scope work; draft labeling intact
requirements.required_evidence: no acceptance of out-of-scope work under D-045; standing holds intact

requirements.text: RELAY / INTEGRATION (return item) — The companion session relays this directive to the live build session with the directive id and scope; the build-session orchestrator integrates the campaign into the master plan (/replan-project) and begins contracting under it. 'Tell the codex loop to build it' is discharged only when the build session acknowledges and the campaign appears in the plan.
requirements.required_harness: cross-session message sent; build-session acknowledgment; master-plan campaign entry
requirements.required_evidence: message record in this capture's audit_log; subsequent master-plan/ledger state
